title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Solid audience‑sourced tape with clear Sennheiser 421 capture, delivering a good show and pleasant sound.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an audience capture that benefits from Gans' Sennheiser 421 microphones, offering a clean and enjoyable listening experience. Reviewers also note the overall quality of the performance, calling it a good show worth downloading.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; it highlights both decent sound quality and an enjoyable show, leading to a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear audience capture with Sennheiser 421 mics; praised as one of the nicer audience tapes despite minor subjective preference.
